subject: [PATCH v3 5/7] sched/numa: scan PID-inactive VMAs for promotion

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) memory management to scan VMAs (Virtual Memory Areas) that are not currently active due to lack of recent PID activity. This allows for promotion-only scans, which update the VMA's previous scan sequence but do not advance the placement-starvation horizon. The patch also introduces a new field in the vma_numab_state structure to track the last completed placement scan separately from other scans. This change is intended to improve memory tiering and reduce CXL bandwidth utilization on hosts with large amounts of DRAM and CXL memory.
